L'entreprise Ooredoo Algérie a mené, le: On Monday, November 23, 2026, Ooredoo Algeria carried out its third blood donation drive of the year for its staff. This civic initiative took place simultaneously across the company's three facilities located in Algiers, Oran, and Constantine, in partnership with the National Blood Agency.
Cet événement s'inscrit dans le cadre de: This event is part of the company's corporate social responsibility strategy, aimed at promoting voluntary blood donation and raising workers' awareness of this humanitarian action.
